name: local-imagen
description: Local AI image generation for Claude: ComfyUI in Docker + FLUX.2 klein 4B. Game projects carry a style guide managed by chat (styles, characters, creatures, locations, props, poses, cameras) so images stay consistent; every Claude session is isolated; a private candidate picker (image-picker agent) shows you only the best image; a Blender pose renderer draws mannequin pose guides for action shots.
